> [!TIP]
> **Have an idea or enhancement?** We welcome proposals from developers, merchants, and shoppers. Please check [existing issues](https://github.com/Oi-Technologies-Official/BanglaQR-Payment-Gateway-by-Oi/issues) to ensure your idea hasn't already been suggested.

## 💡 Feature Overview
<!-- A short, clear summary of what you would like to see added or improved in the plugin -->


## 🎯 Problem Statement / Use Case
<!-- What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a specific pain point or merchant limitation? -->
<!-- Example: "Currently, merchants must manually verify each receipt in admin. It would be helpful to..." -->


## 🚀 Proposed Solution
<!-- Describe the solution you would like to see implemented. How should it work from an admin or customer viewpoint? -->


## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups / Screenshots (Optional)
<!-- If you have visual sketches, screenshots of other gateways, or mockups, drag and drop them here -->


## 🔄 Alternatives Considered (Optional)
<!-- Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or third-party tools you have considered -->


## 👥 Target Audience
- [ ] Store Owners / Merchants
- [ ] Customers / Shoppers
- [ ] Developers / Theme Integrators
- [ ] All of the above

## 💻 Technical Implementation Ideas (Optional)
<!-- Any technical hints, API endpoints, or WordPress/WooCommerce hooks that could be relevant -->


## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate request.
- [ ] I have provided a descriptive title and clear explanation.
- [ ] I am willing to help test or provide feedback on this feature when implemented.
